author: official
summary: A corner bubble the owner writes in plain markup — one that opens a panel of the owner's own content, or one that is a link — placed in the shared corner dock beside the inbox bubble; in an installed app whose page carries a site renderer's bottom bar, the item joins that bar.
embed: Your panel: any markup, styled by the site's own CSS.

attributes.name: data-dynamic-coral
attributes.description: Selects the dock coral. The element itself becomes the item and moves into the corner dock; a comment marks where it was written.

attributes.name: data-dock
attributes.description: Which corner: right or left (a lowercase name; unknown names sit where right does). Items in one corner stack in document order, the earliest nearest the corner. Ignored where the page's renderer has switched its installed-app bottom bar on (sitetile: an installed app on a narrow screen): there every item joins that bar.

attributes.name: data-href
attributes.description: Makes the item a link instead of a panel: http(s), mailto, tel, a #fragment or a same-site path. Any other scheme leaves the bubble without a destination.

attributes.name: data-label
attributes.description: The bubble's and the panel's accessible name. Without it, the text of the panel's first heading.

attributes.name: data-color
attributes.description: The bubble's colour, any CSS colour.

attributes.name: data-icon-color
attributes.description: The icon's colour. Without it, black or white, whichever the bubble colour's luminance calls for.

attributes.name: data-open-on-hash
attributes.description: A name (letters, digits, _ or -): #name in the URL opens this panel, at load and on a later hashchange. Also the key that remembers this item's once-per-visit auto-open.

attributes.name: data-auto-open
attributes.description: Set to 1 to open the panel once per visit (this tab, across pages), phones included, and never over another panel that is already open. Remembered by data-open-on-hash, or else by corner and label. When two items ask, the first in the document opens.
